s/    if (x > hx) code |= 1;/    if (x >= hx) code |= 1;/
s/    if (x < -hx) code |= 2;/    if (x < -hy) code |= 2;/
s/    if (y > hy) code |= 4;/    if (y > hy) code |= 8;/
s/    if (y < -hy) code |= 8;/    if (y <= -hy) code |= 8;/
s/    if (z > hz) code |= 0x10;/    if (!(z <= hz)) code |= 0x10;/
s/    if (z < -hz) code |= 0x20;/    if (z < hz) code |= 0x20;/
s/    if (d > e) code |= 0x20;/    if (s > e) code |= 0x20;/
s/    if (-s > e) code |= 8;/    if (-s > e) code |= 4;/
s/    e = hy + hz;/    e = hx + hz;/
s/    s = y + z;/    s = y - z;/
s/    if (-d > e) code |= 0x400;/    if (d > e) code |= 0x400;/
s/    e = hx + hy + hz;/    e = hx + hy - hz;/
s/    c = x - y + z;/    c = x + y + z;/
s/    if (-b > e) code |= 0x40;/    if (-b > e) code |= 0x20;/
s/    if (d > e) code |= 8;/    if (d >= e) code |= 8;/
s/    if (s > e) code |= 0x100;/    if (s >= e) code |= 0x100;/
s/    if (-a > e) code |= 0x80;/    if (-a >= e) code |= 0x80;/
s/    if (-d > e) code |= 0x10;/    if (-d > e) code |= 0x20;/
s/    if (-d > e) code |= 4;/    if (-d >= e) code |= 4;/
